cands.name: David Jariustokaeutulelei Tangipa
cands.bio: Republican member of the California State Assembly for District 8 since December 2024. Former field representative for Fresno County Supervisor Nathan Magsig and a real estate professional. Fresno State graduate (2017) with a graduate degree (2019), and a former Fresno State football player.

endorsements.text: For 2026, Ballotpedia lists endorsements from the Republican Party of California and Reform California.

In 2024, his campaign survey listed endorsements from Sen. Shannon Grove, Assemblymember Jim Patterson, Fresno Mayor Jerry Dyer, Fresno District Attorney Lisa Smittcamp, Fresno County Sheriff John Zanoni and others.

cands.gaps: We found no bills he sponsored (the Ballotpedia sponsored-legislation table was empty in the page we had) and no specific actions in office that we could verify. We found no stated positions from him on data centers, development or growth limits, homestead property taxes, foreign or investor land buying, H-1B or immigration enforcement, guns, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. His campaign site says he opposes higher taxes and needless regulations, but that is general and not tied to a specific proposal. He did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 candidate survey. We found no news coverage of controversies, and no documented foreign ties. His campaign site mentions that he has worked on lawsuits to protect local control, but gives no details.

local.label: Roots 100: He says he was born and raised in Sacramento (growing up in North Highlands) and has lived his entire adult life in Fresno; this comes from his own campaign biography and Ballotpedia survey answers.

qual.background: Assemblymember for District 8 since December 2024. Before that he was a field representative for Fresno County Supervisor Nathan Magsig and worked in real estate. He holds an MBA and a political science and criminology degree.
qual.why: He has held a legislative office, and his staff work for a county supervisor plus his MBA add policy and business background. Committee seats and the Budget Vice-Chair post were not counted. He has served only about one term.
